turns: What do I buy most often at the grocery store?
needs: Top products or product groups by frequency and euro total from the receipts, one specific observation (e.g. a repeated item), and one concrete suggestion with a euro figure.

turns: How much did I spend on snacks and sweets in the last three months?
needs: Euro total and share of grocery spend for snacks and sweets over a stated 3-month window, a specific example from the receipts, and a practical tip.

turns: Has the price of the milk and bread I buy gone up lately?
needs: Compares unit prices of the specific dairy and bread products over time from receipts, states the change in cents or percent, and says honestly if data is thin.

turns: Is there a cheaper alternative to the stuff I buy at Alepa all the time?
needs: Names his most repeated Alepa items, suggests cheaper alternatives (other chain or own-brand) with price difference, tied to his tight budget.

turns: paljonko oon polttanu energiajuomiin tänä vuonna
needs: Euro total and number of cans for the energy drink product group this year, monthly equivalent, and a casual non-judgmental suggestion with savings figure.

turns: how much do I spend on beer and cider from the shop vs bars?
needs: Euro totals for beer and cider in receipts versus bar category in bank data over the same period, and an observation about the split.

turns: How much are we spending on ready meals and could we cook instead?
needs: Euro total of ready meals from receipts, typical price per item, and a cook-at-home alternative with an estimated saving; may use general cost knowledge.

turns: Onko mun ruokakori terveellinen vai epäterveellinen? Mitä ostan eniten?
needs: Share of fruit and vegetables versus snacks, sweets, ready meals and soft drinks from the receipts with euro figures, balanced and non-preachy, with one concrete improvement.

turns: Which of Prisma, S-market, Alepa or Sale is cheapest for me?
needs: Compares his spend and prices across the chains for comparable products, notes basket size and trip counts per chain, and gives a clear recommendation with a euro estimate.

turns: Do I do more small top-up trips or big weekly shops, and what is my average basket?
needs: Counts of small versus large shops, average basket in euros, which chains are used for each, and what the pattern costs her.

turns: What could I cut from my groceries without noticing?
How much would that save in a year?
needs: Turn 1: specific products/groups that are impulse or pricey with euro amounts. Turn 2: a yearly saving computed from those same items, consistent with turn 1.

turns: Do I spend more on food than a typical household?
needs: Her monthly grocery spend versus Statistics Finland or group figures for a comparable household, stating the difference and what the comparison does not capture.

turns: Based on what I normally buy, help me plan dinners for next week on a budget
make it vegetarian two nights
needs: A dinner plan built from products she actually buys with approximate euro costs; turn 2 adjusts two nights to vegetarian, staying consistent and within budget.

turns: How much have I spent on fuel this year and what is it per month?
needs: Total fuel spend this year to date, monthly average, number of fill-ups and average per fill-up, with a note on the highest month.

turns: paljonko tankkaamiseen on mennyt kesällä
entä viime kesänä?
kumpi oli kalliimpaa ja miksi
needs: Summer 2026 fuel total, then summer 2025 total, then a comparison with a plausible reason from data (more fill-ups, longer trips, larger fill-ups) or honest uncertainty about price.

turns: Do I fill up at ABC at certain times, and is it costing me more than needed?
needs: Fill-up frequency, weekdays and times, average amount, and whether anything stands out; caution about inferring fuel prices that are not in data.

turns: How much did I spend on restaurants since Christmas?
needs: Restaurant category total from 25 December 2025 to 26 September 2026, monthly average, count of visits, average per visit, with a comparison to fast food.

turns: Compare this summer to last summer
which category changed the most?
needs: Summer 2026 versus summer 2025 total spend with euro and percent difference; turn 2 names the category with the biggest change and the amounts.

turns: Paljonko meni rahaa viimeisinä kolmena viikonloppuna?
needs: Total spend for the last three weekends, broken down per weekend and top categories, casual tone.

turns: Is my spending going up?
what's driving it?
needs: Compares recent months to earlier ones with euro and percent change; turn 2 names the categories driving the rise using data.

turns: Which category grew most this year?
needs: The category with the largest increase this year versus last, with euro amounts and percent, plus possible reasons or a suggestion to check.

turns: Miksi viime kuu oli niin kallis?
needs: August 2026 total versus her normal month, the categories and individual large purchases that explain the gap, and whether it was a one-off.

turns: why was last month so expensive
and the month before?
needs: Explains last month's spend with specific categories and large purchases; turn 2 gives the same analysis for the month before and compares the two.

turns: Do I spend more on weekdays or weekends?
what about Fridays specifically?
needs: Average spend per weekday versus weekend day with euro figures; turn 2 gives Friday's average and what he buys on Fridays.

turns: What time of day do I spend the most?
needs: Spend by time-of-day bands with euro totals, the peak band, and what categories dominate it.

turns: Paljonko kulutan palkkapäivän jälkeen ekalla viikolla?
needs: Share and euro amount spent in the first week after payday versus the rest of the month, with the main categories.

turns: Show me my late-night purchases
needs: Purchases after about 11pm or midnight with total, count, typical amounts and categories such as bar, fast food and taxi, plus one observation.

turns: What does a typical night out cost me?
how many have I had this year?
what if I cut it by a third?
needs: A typical night-out total (bar, food, taxi) from the data, count of nights this year, and a saving computed by cutting a third, consistent across turns.

turns: What was my biggest purchase this year, and the biggest one that was not housing?
needs: Names the largest transaction with date, amount and category, and the largest non-housing one, with context.

turns: Mikä on mun yleisin ostos ja paljonko pienet ostokset yhteensä on?
needs: Most frequent purchase category or recurring amount with count, and the euro total of small purchases under a stated threshold.

turns: List my recurring charges and subscriptions
needs: A list of recurring charges identifiable from bank data (utilities, housing, entertainment) with monthly amounts and a total.

turns: Am I paying for anything I forgot about?
needs: Candidates among small recurring charges in entertainment or other categories with monthly and yearly amounts, honestly noting merchants are anonymous.

turns: How much did I earn last year? Is my income stable?
needs: Total salary in 2025, monthly average, month-to-month variation including any bonus months, and a verdict on stability.

turns: Paljonko palkkaa oon saanu kuukaudessa keskimäärin?
needs: Average monthly salary and range over the period, noting variability if shifts or irregular pay show in the data.

turns: When was my balance lowest in the last two years?
needs: The date and amount of his lowest balance, what led up to it, and how often he got near zero.

turns: Am I richer than a year ago?
needs: Balance now versus a year ago from the data, the difference, and savings or investment contributions that explain it.

turns: Onko tilini saldo kasvanut vai pienentynyt vuodessa?
needs: Balance now versus a year ago with euro change, and the monthly pattern.

turns: What do I spend on regular essentials every month, the things I can't avoid?
needs: Monthly total and breakdown of regular essentials (housing, utilities, groceries, pharmacy) from the data, share of income, and a note on what is flexible.

turns: How much went on unexpected stuff this year, like repairs, medical or things I had to buy?
needs: Identifies unplanned necessities (pharmacy, health, car or electronics) in the data with euro totals and dates, and a suggested buffer amount.

turns: Mihin rahaa menee huomaamatta, tälleen pikkujuttuihin?
needs: Small frequent purchases (fast food, snacks, coffee, taxis) with count and euro total over a period, and the yearly figure.

turns: Tell me something I don't know about my spending
needs: One or two non-obvious, data-backed insights with specific figures, such as a pattern in receipts or timing.

turns: Surprise me
needs: An engaging, specific, data-backed fact about his habits with numbers, not generic advice.

turns: kerro jotain yllättävää mun kulutuksesta
needs: A surprising specific finding from bank data or receipts with euro figures, in casual Finnish.

turns: How do I compare to other people my age in my area?
where am I higher?
needs: Her spend by main category versus the peer group, and in turn 2 the categories where she is above the group with euro differences.

turns: Kuluttaako muut mun ikäiset enemmän ruokaan?
entä lääkkeisiin?
needs: Compares his food spend with same-age peers, then pharmacy spend, with euro figures and a non-judgmental takeaway.

turns: How much have I spent on cola and energy drinks, and what would that be as a monthly bill?
needs: Euro total for soft and energy drinks over a period, a monthly equivalent, and a swap suggestion with savings.

turns: How much did we spend on meat and fish last month?
is that normal for a family?
what could be swapped?
needs: Meat and fish euro total for August 2026, a comparison against group or national household figures, then specific swaps with savings.

turns: Which product I buy often has gotten most expensive?
needs: Identifies a repeated product whose unit price rose most with before and after prices and percent change, and how much extra it costs her.

turns: Am I paying different prices for the same items at Prisma and Alepa?
needs: Examples of products bought in both chains with unit price gaps, and how much switching would save.

turns: Paljonko meni karkkiin ja naposteluun?
onko se paljon?
needs: Euro total for snacks and sweets with monthly figure, then a context comparison against peers or his food budget.

turns: Do I buy enough fruit and vegetables? How much a month?
needs: Monthly euro and share of fruit and vegetables in receipts, a gentle comparison with typical guidance, and an easy suggestion.

turns: Which day do I do most of my grocery shopping and does it matter for price?
needs: Grocery trips by weekday, average basket per day, and whether the day links to higher or lower spend.

turns: Paljonko alkoholiin menee kuussa ruokakaupassa?
needs: Monthly euro for beer and cider product groups in receipts, share of grocery bill, and perhaps bar spend for context.

turns: Is my car costing more than it should? Fuel plus anything else car related
needs: Fuel total and car-related categories from the data with monthly figures, and an honest note about what the data cannot show (insurance, depreciation).

turns: How much did taxis and public transport cost me over the last 6 months, and what if half my taxi rides were bus rides?
needs: Totals for taxi and public transport with ride counts, average taxi fare, and a hypothetical saving with a stated assumption for the bus fare.

turns: How much did we spend on travel and holidays last summer in total?
needs: Travel category spend for summer 2025 with dates and largest items, plus anything related to restaurants or entertainment during the trip.

turns: Has my salary changed since I started?
how much is left after the fixed bills each month?
needs: Salary level over time with any change dated, then average leftover after housing and utilities; relevant to her mortgage plan.

turns: Is my grocery bill high for one person?
needs: His monthly grocery spend versus Statistics Finland figures for a single-person household or his peer group, with a plain verdict.

turns: Is my grocery spending rising faster than prices?
show me month by month
needs: Grocery trend in euros with percent change, mention of general food inflation as context, then a monthly table or list.

turns: Mitä voisin tehdä ruoalla jota ostan, että säästäisin 50 e kuussa?
needs: A concrete plan from her receipts (swaps, fewer impulse items, store choice) adding up to about 50 euros a month, with figures.
